acceptanceCriteria: A timeout with no matching request in the server log is reported as request-never-sent with the earlier 4xx on the same page.
A timeout whose request reached the server but responded late is reported as slow-response with its duration.
A role=alert locator against a component rendering a plain element with no role is reported before any run.
Missing logs or unresolvable components abstain rather than report.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1197. (1) Runtime: when a response wait times out, check the run's server request log or browser network log for a request matching the predicate during the wait; none -> report 'request never sent' with the preceding failed (4xx/5xx) navigation/resolver requests on the same page; matched but late -> 'slow response' with duration. (2) Static: role-based locators (e.g. role=alert) targeting a component's error/notification output must match a role the component's markup renders; report mismatch with component path. Abstain when logs or markup are unresolved.
title: GH #1197: RESPONSE-WAIT diagnosis - request never sent vs slow response, and role locators the component never renders
